environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, and (2) a custom rule group 'internal-sqli-shield' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values using pattern `(?i)(?:'\s*(?:or|and|union|select|from|where|having|order|group|insert|update|delete|drop|alter|create|exec|execute)|--\s*$|/\*|\*/|;\s*(?:select|drop|insert|update|delete))` with action BLOCK, priority 1. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /health. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on test payloads matching the pattern.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL 'prod-api-acl'
config.network: private subnet, no IGW, ALB in public subnet
config.security_group_task: inbound only from ALB SG on port 8080
